senses.gloss:
मठ् {c1c} P. (मठति)
1 To dwell,
inhabit.
--2 To go.
--3 To grind.

मठः, --ठं [मठत्यत्र मठ् घञर्थे क]
1
The hut of an ascetic, a small cell
or room.
--2 A monastery, convent.
--3 A seminary, college, place of
learning.
--4 A temple.
--5 A cart
drawn by oxen.
--ठी
1 A cell.
--2 A cloister, convent.
--Comp.
--आयतनं a monastery, college.
--चिंता charge of a convent;
Pt. 2. 63.
